simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מוֹרָשׁ (H4180) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מוֹרָשׁ (môwrâsh) means a possession ; figuratively, delight First listed occurrence: Isa 14 23.

definitions.full: H4180. morash [ מוֺרָשׁ ] noun [masculine] a possession ; — construct קִמֹּד מוֺרַשׁ Isa 14:23 a possession for bitterns ; מוֺרָשֵׁיהֶם אֵת יַעֲקֹב בֵּית וְיָרְשׁוּ Obadiah 17 and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions (but read perhaps מורישׁיהם their dispossessors , ᵑ7 ᵑ9 ᵐ5 and others); figurative לְבָבִי מוֺרָשֵׁי Job 17:11 , i.e. my cherished thoughts (|| זִמּוֺתַי ), but figurative is questionable, see Di, who derives from ארשׁ desire, so Buhl.
